title: Functional utilities behind the primary street setback and not visible from the primary street
text: C2.5.2 Functional utilities (with the exception of solar collectors and electric vehicle charging): i. are located behind the primary street setback and not visible from the primary street; ii. are designed to integrate with the development; and iii. are located and/or screened so that they are not visually obtrusive and minimise the impact of noise sources to habitable rooms and private open space both on the development site and adjoining properties.

replaces.note: Part B only required screening / not obtrusive; draft adds 'behind the primary street setback and not visible from the primary street' at R40 and below
secondary-street screening of clothes drying on corner lots dropped

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 2 - Single Houses.pdf

notes: Only sub-clause (i) is encoded; (ii) 'integrate with the development' and (iii) 'not visually obtrusive, minimise noise impact' need planner judgment and fall to M2.5. Functional utilities: air conditioning, plant, clothes drying, hot water, antennas and dishes, inverters and batteries, rainwater tanks; solar collectors and EV charging excluded.
